content.short: Deeper Network offers decentralized VPN hardware and Web3 privacy tools.
content.description: Deeper Network provides a decentralized VPN infrastructure that protects networks while enabling bandwidth farming so participants can earn token rewards. Purchasing the hardware VPN connects you to the network and secures the traffic of your devices. The network spans a global footprint of more than 80,000 nodes across over 150 countries, collectively defending networks against more than 100 million threats. The arrangement emphasizes decentralized protection and secure, connected devices, while offering token-based rewards for participants.
content.meta: Deeper Network builds decentralized VPN infrastructure and Web3 privacy tools. Discover Deeper Network and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
